# `silk/crypto/ripemd160`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Compute RIPEMD-160 digests for formats that name them, such as Bitcoin addresses.

## When to use
Use [`Ripemd160`](#Ripemd160) only where a format requires RIPEMD-160. Use SHA-256 for new protocols.

## Details
The streaming state does not allocate. Call `make`, `update`, and `finish`, or use `hash`. The
digest is 20 bytes.

## Examples
### Hash a message in parts
```silk
import silk.crypto.ripemd160 { Ripemd160 }

pub fn main() -> i32 {
  let mut state = Ripemd160.make()
  state.update(b"a")
  state.update(b"bc")
  let digest = state.finish()
  // RIPEMD-160("abc") is 8eb208f7...0bfc.
  if digest[0] != 0x8e || digest[19] != 0xfc {
    return 1
  }
  return 0
}
```

## See also
[The RIPEMD-160 page](https://homes.esat.kuleuven.be/~bosselae/ripemd160.html) defines the
algorithm and its test vectors.

Import as `Ripemd160` with `import silk.crypto.ripemd160 { Ripemd160 }`.
